description: A logical layer that groups diagram nodes for visibility and locking control.

members.name: IsLocked
members.description: When true, nodes on this layer cannot be moved or deleted.

members.name: IsVisible
members.description: When false, nodes on this layer are hidden from the canvas.

members.name: Name
members.description: Display name shown in the layers panel.

members.name: Order
members.description: Order used for sorting layers in the UI (lower = first).
